movelist.name: Future Sight
movelist.effect: Future Sight does nothing on the turn it is used. At the end of the user’s next turn, Future Sight hits, even if the user is no longer on the field. Future Sight cannot miss.

movelist.name: Refresh
movelist.effect: The user is cured of all Poison, Burns, and Paralysis.

movelist.name: Hyper Voice
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are pushed back to the squares immediately outside the blast, away from the user.

movelist.name: Earth Power
movelist.effect: Earth Power lowers the Special Defense of all Legal Targets 1 Combat Stage on 16+.

movelist.name: Gravity
movelist.effect: For 5 rounds, the area is considered Warped. While Warped, Moves that involve the user being airborne may not be used. Pokémon cannot use Sky or Levitate Capabilities to end their turn at an altitude higher than 1 meter. Flying-Types and Pokémon with the Ability Levitate no longer resist Ground-Type Moves, and Pokémon cannot use Sky or Levitate Capabilities for immunity to Moves with the Groundsource keyword. All Accuracy Rolls receive a +2 Bonus.

abilities.name: Multitype
abilities.effect: The user changes its Elemental Type to any of the Elemental Types. Multitype cannot be copied or disabled.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.trigger: The user is recalled into a Poké Ball, or Takes
abilities.effect: The user gains Hit Points equal to 1/3rd of its maximum Hit Points. Regenerator may be activated only once per Scene.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.effect: The user gains a +1d10 Bonus to Damage Rolls with Moves with which they apply STAB.
